text: ぼくたち　トレーナーの　バッグは　べんりな　しかけが　ついてるぞ！

structure.jp: ぼくたち　トレーナーの　バッグは
べんりな　しかけが　ついてるぞ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, which here says something is in a lasting state. ついてる = 'is attached, comes with it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way of pushing your point. ついてるぞ = 'it comes with one, I tell you!'.
